mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the air sacs beside capillaries was most worthwhile: the arrows made gas exchange clear without suggesting that air and blood mix.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the finished airways and sacs was predictable, and the final picture mostly repeated what I expected.

surprise.text: It clarified that oxygen and carbon dioxide cross in opposite directions while air and blood remain separate.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary. The elastic tissue was initially a named pairing, but its stretch-and-recoil picture made its purpose clearer.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing how the lung parts fit together was interesting, especially the separate air and blood spaces, even though the last choices were straightforward.
